22/11/25  

29F new pt walk-in  

CC: “having these scary thoughts about hurting the baby” 3/12 postnatal  

Hx:  
1st baby NSVD 3/12 ago BF + formula  
6–8/52 ↑low mood, anhedonia, fatigue, poor conc, crying “most days”  
Intrusive ego-dystonic images harming baby (stairs, smothering) very distressed by this “I’d never do it but the pictures keep popping in” avoids being alone w baby  
Passive SI “wish I wouldn’t wake up some days” no plan/intent no prev attempts  
Sleep ↓ (baby wakes 2–3x, then racing thoughts)  
Appetite ↓ ~4–5kg wt loss (pt report)  
Marked anxiety re baby health + checking, reassurance seeking  
Panic attacks 2–3/wk (palps SOB tremor fear “I’ll lose it and do something stupid”) 10–15min self-resolve  
No psychotic Sx, no bizarre beliefs re baby  

PMHx: GAD + panic since teens  
Prev sertraline 50mg mane ~18/12 ago good effect but poor adherence → self-ceased when pregnant  
Old diazepam 2mg PRN panic >1 yr ago, none now  
No other sig PMHx, NKDA  

Meds: nil regular, occas paracetamol  
Caffeine ~5–6 cups instant coffee/day  

Risk:  
SI passive only, no plan, no access to unusual means  
Infanticidal thoughts intrusive only, ego-dystonic, no plan/intent, scared of thoughts not baby  
Good insight, strong attachment to baby, supports (partner, mum), self-presented  
Overall low–mod risk today, suitable community f/up  

Exam (brief):  
Obs WNL BP 112/70 HR 86 afeb SpO2 99% RA  
MSE: tired, mildly dishevelled but caring for baby appropriately, cooperative, tearful, mood “really low and anxious”, affect congruent anxious, TP coherent, TC as above, no psychosis, orientated, good insight/judgement  

Ix:  
Plan baseline FBC U&E LFT TSH B12/folate (form given)  

Dx:  
1. Postnatal depression mod–severe with intrusive harm thoughts (ego-dystonic) no psychosis  
2. GAD + panic d/o exacerbated perinatal  
3. Sleep disturbance + high caffeine contributing  
4. Hx poor adherence meds/referrals  

Plan:  
Safety: discussed at length  
– Pt agrees if thoughts feel “out of control” will not stay alone w baby → call partner/mum to take over  
– Given ED / MH triage / Lifeline / PANDA nos  
– Advised urgent review/ED if ↑SI or any intent/plan re self or baby or psychotic Sx  

Meds:  
– Start sertraline 25mg mane 7/7 → ↑50mg mane if tol (prev effective) PBS  
   Rationale: mod–severe PND + GAD, breastfeeding compatible, risks of non-tx > med risk  
– Discussed SEs (GI, headache, initial ↑anxiety), onset 2–4/52, need to continue 6–12/12 once better  
– No benzos (BF + dependence)  
– Adv ↓ caffeine to ≤2 cups/day  

Adherence strategies: link dose to morning feed, phone alarms, ask mum to remind  

Psych:  
– Needs MH Treatment Plan + CBT/IPT perinatal  
– Time short today → booked longer appt next wk to do MHTP + make referrals while here (pt admits “I never get around to calling”)  
– Consider telehealth perinatal services (eg Gidget, PANDA) next visit  

Mother–infant:  
– Reassured intrusive thoughts are part of anxiety/depression not intent to harm  
– Will explore parent–infant / early childhood service referral at f/up  

F/up:  
– Review 5–7/7 booked before leaving  
   • Reassess mood, SI, harm thoughts, panic  
   • Check sertraline tol/adherence  
   • Repeat EPDS in 2–4/52  
   • Do MHTP + referrals  
   • Review bloods if done  
RTC earlier / ED if deterioration as above  

Pt tearful but relieved, says “I don’t want to be like this anymore I’ll try the meds this time” acknowledges hx missing appts – reception to send SMS reminder.

34F teacher, non-smoker. Known health anxiety.  

CC: “vax update” + cough  

HPI  
- 5–6/7 cough post-URTI  
- Dry → mildly productive yellow sputum  
- Chest tight/tender “from coughing”  
- Intermittent nocturnal wheeze, mild DOE uphill  
- No pleuritic pain, no haemoptysis, no wt loss, no rigors, no documented fever  
- Concerned re ?pneumonia / ?lung Ca, requesting CXR/bloods  
- Thinks bleach / dusty air-con may have triggered  

Vax  
- Wants “school shots” – asks re dTpa, flu, “pneumonia one”, COVID  
- No records. dTpa >10 yrs by recall, missed this yr’s flu, last COVID ~2 yrs (?)  

PMHx: nil asthma/COPD/cardiac. No reg meds. NKDA. No recent travel, no known COVID/pertussis contacts.  

Obs 09:00  
- BP 112/70  
- HR 84 reg  
- RR 16  
- Temp 36.9°C  
- SpO₂ 99% RA  
- BMI ~24 (est)  

Ex  
- Gen: Well, anxious, speaking full sentences, no ↑WOB  
- ENT: Mild nasal congestion, mild pharyngeal erythema, no exudate  
- Chest: CW tenderness sternally on palp/cough. Exp wheeze diffuse, coarse insp crackles clearing w cough. No focal creps, no bronchial BS. Good AE bilat  
- CVS: HS dual, no murmur, no oedema  

Impression  
1) Acute bronchitis post-URTI (?viral LRTI) – no clinical features of PNA/HF/pertussis  
2) Health anxiety – reassurance seeking, heavy “Dr Google” use  
3) Vax status unclear – non-urgent, defer until current resp illness settled  
?CXR if sx >3/52 or red flags  

Ix  
- No bloods/CXR today – low yield, obs/exam reassuring. Explained.  
- No RAT/PCR – >5/7 sx, mild, no high-risk contacts  

Plan 09:12  
Acute bronchitis  
- Dx + natural hx explained (cough up to 3/52, sometimes 8/52)  
- No ABx / steroids / SABA / OTC combo meds – not indicated uncomplicated acute bronchitis  
- Analgesia:  
  - Paracetamol 500–1000 mg PO q4–6h PRN (max 4 g/24h)  
  - Ibuprofen 200–400 mg PO TDS PRN with food if needed, short term  
- General: fluids, avoid irritant cleaning products/smoke, ok to use steam with care  
- Safety-net: ED/urgent review if ↑SOB at rest, pleuritic CP, fever >38° >48h, rigors, confusion, haemoptysis, or generally much worse. RTC if no improvement 7–10/7 or cough >3/52 → consider CXR / chronic cough w/u  

Vax  
- Defer non-urgent vax until cough settled (~1–2/52)  
- Plan next visit:  
  - Flu vax (missed this season)  
  - dTpa booster (likely >10 yrs)  
  - Check COVID booster need per ATAGI once AIR/MyGov record available  
  - Pneumococcal not indicated at 34F otherwise well – discussed briefly  
- Asked to bring AIR printout/MyGov record next appt  
- Book nurse/GP vax appt 1–2/52 once improved  

Health anxiety  
- Validated concern, advised reducing online searching  
- Structured reassurance given re low risk Ca/PNA today, clear follow-up plan  
- Offered longer appt later if ongoing health worry → consider CBT/psychology referral; pt prefers to “see how cough goes first”  

F/U  
- RN/GP review 1–2/52: cough reassess + vax update  
- Earlier review if red flags / deterioration

source_note:
22/11/25  AM

42F here mainly for “lower back’s been a bit crook the last couple of weeks” – also ended up talking about her being sleepy all the time.

Back – about 2 wks, gradual, central low lumbar, a bit to R side. Dull ache, can be sharp bending, up to ~6–7/10 if pushed but says “mostly just annoying”. Worse after long periods at desk, lifting shopping. A bit stiff first 10–15 mins in the morning then eases. No leg pain, no pins/needles, no weakness, no bowel/bladder change, no saddle numbness, no fevers/wt loss/night sweats, no trauma. Thinks maybe new office chair / slept funny on couch. Still working part-time, just avoiding heavier jobs at home.

Exam (limited – running late): looks tired but comfortable. BP 118/72, HR 74, afebrile, sats 99% RA, BMI ~27. Mild tenderness R lumbar paraspinals, no midline tenderness. Slight ↓ flexion with pain but can move in all directions. SLR neg both sides, LL power/reflexes/sensation grossly normal, gait ok.

Impression: acute mechanical LBP, likely muscular strain / posture related. No red flags today, no radiculopathy.

Plan back:
- Reassured. Expect improvement over next few weeks.
- Paracetamol 1 g up to QID PRN – encouraged to actually use short term if needed.
- Heat, keep moving, avoid long periods sitting – brief chat re desk ergonomics.
- Offered physio; she reluctant re cost, wants to see if settles first.
- RTC/ED if new neuro sx, bowel/bladder issues, night pain, fevers, trauma etc.

While talking, hypersomnolence came up – longstanding. Says “I could nap pretty much any time, anywhere”, partner apparently complains she nods off on couch and at work. She minimises (“probably nothing, partner going on about it”). Known hx of “periodic limb movements” on sleep study ~2 yrs ago with private sleep specialist in Sydney – no records in Best Practice, not on treatment. Kicks in sleep, partner disturbed. No snoring/apnoeas per partner, no cataplexy, no sleep paralysis or hallucinations. In bed ~10–11pm, up 6–6:30, unrefreshed. Drives short distances, admits feels “drowsy a lot”, has zoned out at red lights but denies actually falling asleep driving.

Mood – known depression on sertraline 50 mg mane, misses “a few here and there”. Low motivation, fatigue, poor concentration, “foggy”, but denies current SI. No other major PMHx. NKDA. Non-smoker, minimal ETOH.

Partner (not present but per pt) quite worried re daytime sleepiness and driving, thinks she is underplaying it.

Today’s focus limited (time) but concern re hypersomnolence + PLMS + depression mix, and driving risk. Aetiology not clear – ?idiopathic hypersomnolence vs other central disorder, old workup incomplete.

Plan sleep/mood:
- Advised not to drive when sleepy; keep to essential short trips only for now and stop immediately if drowsy.
- Bloods ordered via SNP today: FBC, U&E, LFT, TFT, B12, folate, ferritin, fasting glucose, lipids, ESR/CRP – screen for anaemia, thyroid, nutritional, inflammatory causes of fatigue.
- Will request previous sleep study + letters from private sleep clinic in Sydney (pt gave approximate name).
- Discussed re-referral to sleep physician to review hypersomnolence/PLMS and consider options incl. modafinil or other therapy; she not keen on “strong meds” or more tests but agreed in principle, wants to see bloods first. Referral to be done once records/bloods back (flagged).
- Brief sleep hygiene chat only (consistent bedtime/waketime, screens, caffeine etc.).
- Encouraged regular sertraline (not intermittent). Need longer appt to review depression and whether dose/agent needs change vs sedation.

Follow-up:
- Path today with nurse.
- Book review 1–2 wks for back pain + blood results – asked for longer (20 min) if possible to start proper sleep/depression review.
- Earlier if back worse or any neuro red flags, or if sleepiness worsens / near-miss accident driving.

[Addendum 16:10 – Dr J. Lee]  
Bloods not back yet. Reminder set to chase old sleep study report before next review.

code.text: Acute mechanical low back pain, likely muscular strain/posture related
Reported history of periodic limb movements on a sleep study approximately 2 years ago; records unavailable

Periodic limb movements during sleep (previously identified on sleep study; ongoing kicking during sleep)

22/11/25 08:42  

34M SA background batt. recycling worker  

CC: wants “same capsules for high lead” + iron repeat. “Only got 10 mins need to get back to work”  

Hx  
Known occ lead exposure ~5y on sorting/crushing line. Prev seen other clinic (no records) – told “lead levels high” → had course of “capsules to clean it out” + iron. Likely oral chelation (succimer) completed months ago.  
Now mostly well. Mild fatigue only – attributes to double shifts / ↓sleep. Denies headache abdo pain N/V constip neuro Sx mood/cog change SOB CP.  
Insists on repeat chelation “worked last time” but understands after brief explanation that unsafe w/o current BLL.  
No current meds. No known allergies.  

SH (brief)  
Long shifts, hard to get time off. PPE use inconsistent (mask off when hot).  

Ex  
Obs: BP 132/84 HR 78 RR 14 SpO₂ 99% RA T 36.6 BMI ~27  
Gen well, no distress. Neuro grossly NAD. CVS/Resp/Abdo unremarkable. No obvious pallor or Burton line.  

Impr  
1) Occ lead exposure / ?chronic low-level lead toxicity – currently asx. No prior results available. Not safe to re-start chelation empirically.  
2) Hx iron deficiency – off iron for several months. Likely contributing to fatigue + ↑lead absorption risk.  
3) Fatigue – likely multifactorial (shift work + probable Fe def).  

Plan  
– Explained cannot “just repeat” chelation w/o BLL + tox input. Pt reluctantly agrees to bloods today.  
– Path (S&N):  
  • Whole blood lead level (urgent, occ exposure)  
  • FBC  
  • U&E, Cr, LFT  
  • Iron studies (ferritin, iron, TIBC)  
  • Zn/Cu if lab can do  
– Meds:  
  • Start ferrous sulfate 325 mg PO mane (≈105 mg elemental) with vit C drink. Warn constipation / dark stools. Avoid tea/coffee around dose.  
  • NO chelation Rx today – document: do NOT re-start chelation unless BLL↑ and after tox advice.  
– Brief occ advice: consistent PPE, no eating in work area, wash hands, change/shower after shift. Suggest discuss with workplace H&S re monitoring / possible role change if BLL↑.  
– Safety net: ED if severe headache confusn seizures severe abdo pain vomiting new neuro Sx. RTC if fatigue/SOB worse.  

F/up  
– Review 1/52 (or earlier if results back sooner) to discuss BLL + iron studies.  
– If BLL significantly ↑ → urgent discussion with clinical toxicologist / Poisons Info, consider removal from exposure ± hospital-based chelation.  
– If Fe def confirmed → continue oral Fe ≥3/12 after Hb/ferritin normal. Consider GI workup if marked / unexplained.  

Pt understanding: initially frustrated re no “same script” but agrees to single blood draw today before work.  

08:55 finished (running late)

22/11/25  15:42  

69F f/up abdo pain LLQ. Known sigmoid diverticular disease (CT ~3/12 ago, outpt Rx). Missed colonoscopy + f/up  

HPI  
4–5/7 dull LLQ ache 5–6/10, similar to last episode but milder. Worse y/day. No radiation. Worse w movement / when very full bowels, some relief post BM  
Alt constip/loose over wk. No PR bleed, no melaena. Says stools “a bit narrower sometimes” but not persistent. +flatus. No V+. Mild on/off nausea. Appetite ↓ a bit but still eating  
?fevers/chills day 1–2, no temps recorded. Now just “off” but coping ADLs  
No dysuria, freq, flank pain. No CP, SOB  
Admits only took 3–4/7 of prev Augmentin then stopped. No fibre changes. Still uses ibuprofen intermittently despite prior advice  

Obs  
BP 138/82 HR 88 RR 16 SpO2 98% RA T 37.4 BMI ~26  

Exam (focused)  
Abdo soft ND. LLQ local T+, mild–mod. No guarding/rebound. No gen peritonism. No palpable mass. BS N. No CVA T  

Imp  
1) Recurrent LLQ pain in pt w known sigmoid diverticular disease → likely uncomplicated diverticulitis vs SUDD. Currently stable, tolerating PO, no sepsis / peritonism / obstruction  
2) Non-adherence to prev mgmt (abx incomplete, colonoscopy not done, diet not changed)  
3) Need to excl CRC given age + prev diverticulitis + intermittent narrower stool calibre  

Ix  
– FBC, UEC, CRP, LFT today → SNP path, results pending  
– Urine dip in rooms: NIT -ve LEU -ve blood -ve → UTI unlikely  
→ If bloods abn / sx ↑ or no improvement 24–48h → urgent CT abdo/pelvis w contrast (local imaging) + likely ED  

Plan  
– Treat as presumed uncomplicated diverticulitis  
  • Amoxycillin + clavulanic acid 875/125 PO BD 7/7 (PBS) → stressed must complete course  
  • Analgesia: paracetamol 1 g QID prn. Avoid NSAIDs (↑ GI bleed/divertic risk) – discussed, pt agrees to try stop Nurofen  
  • Diet: low residue/soft 48–72h then ↑ fibre as settles. Encourage fluids  
– Bowels: if constipated → advised OTC macrogol sachets 1–2/d, avoid straining  

Colonoscopy / CRC screen  
– Re-discussed need for post-diverticulitis scope to excl malignancy (age + stool calibre change). Pt reluctant re prep/travel but agrees in principle  
– Re-referral to public hospital gastro/surg for colonoscopy sent today via HealthLink → “post-diverticulitis, r/o malignancy”  
– Suggested daughter assist w prep/transport  

Adherence  
– Forgetful / avoids “hassle”. Suggested pill box + phone alarms. Wrote abx schedule for fridge.  
– Will ask PN to phone in few days to check abx adherence / colonoscopy booking progress  

Safety net  
– ED if sudden severe gen abdo pain, rigid abdo, high fevers/rigors, unable keep fluids down, no stool/flatus + distension/V+, large PR bleed or melaena, presyncope  
– Same-day review here if pain ↑ next 24–48h despite abx or new V+  

F/up  
– Review booked 48h (short appt) → check sx, vitals, path results  
→ If improving + bloods OK → complete 7/7 abx, advance diet, reinforce colonoscopy  
→ If no better / worse → same-day CT abdo/pelvis + likely ED  

Bulk billed today (time mostly acute abdo + adherence + colonoscopy discussion – preventive care deferred, to book longer appt later)

- Perindopril 5 mg mane – often missed.  
- Atorvastatin 20 mg nocte – “when I remember”.  
- Movicol macrogol 3350 + electrolytes – currently nil.  
- Paracetamol PRN.

78F known occ hand derm / atopy / psoriasis. Seen re “dermatitis on my hands + arms – no one can tell if it’s allergy”. Wants “one cream that fixes it”.

HPC  
>20y hx chronic hand/FA rash. Worse last 3–4/12. Burning/itch/cracks ± minor weep. Flares w dishes + “lemon” dish liquid + strong soaps. Using old betamethasone cream “when really bad” often multiple times/day for few days then stops. Emollient poor use (“forget”).

Atopic derm

HTN, OA, CKD3 (eGFR ~55 last yr)  
NKDA

Paracetamol PRN  
Betamethasone valerate 0.05% cream – expired, overused when flare  
Sorbolene (rarely used)  
Promethazine 10 nocte PRN itch – mostly not taking (too sedating)

Adherence poor. Missed prev derm appt (“too far, hate the bus”).

Extensor FA: scattered dry erythematous patches  
Elbows: well-demarcated erythematous plaques w silvery scale c/w psoriasis  
No nail pitting. No urticaria/angioedema

A  
1) Chronic hand/FA derm – mixed picture:  
   - cumulative irritant contact (wet work, detergents, fragranced soaps etc)  
   - ?allergic contact (hx latex rxn, fragranced products, no patch test)  
   - underlying atopic eczema → barrier ↓  
   Mod flare today, no 2° infection  
2) Mild plaque psoriasis elbows – stable  
3) Poor adherence + access issues (rural, transport) → driving poor control

P  
Time limited – focus skin only. Other chronic dz review next visit.

1) Avoidance / barrier  
– Adv stop fragranced bar soap + “lemon” dish liquid → use soap-free wash (e.g. QV/Cetaphil)  
– ↑ emollient: sorbolene / plain ointment ≥3–4x/day esp post handwash  
– Non-latex (nitrile/vinyl) gloves for dishes/cleaning ± cotton liners. Avoid hot water, prolonged wet work  
(briefly explained irritant vs allergic vs atopic overlap – not easily separable, mgmt same re barrier)

2) Topical Rx  
– Cease old betamethasone  
– Start mometasone furoate 0.1% ointment (PBS)  
   • Hands/wrists + FA + elbows: thin layer nocte x 7–10d then alt nights x 1/52 then stop; continue emollient  
   • Max OD, avoid face/groin, not >2/52 continuous  
– Scripts:  
   • Mometasone 0.1% oint 45g x 1 + 1 rpt  
   • Sorbolene 500g tub x 1 + 3 rpts

3) Itch  
– Start cetirizine 10 mg mane PRN itch x 1–2/52 (CKD3 – dose ok)  
– Promethazine discouraged (falls/sedation) – reserve only if severe nocturnal itch

4) Derm / patch testing  
– Discussed benefit patch testing (rubber accelerators, fragrance, preservatives etc) given hx latex + chronicity  
– Referral to nearest regional derm svc for contact derm assessment + patch test if possible  
   Pt ambivalent (“I’ll see”) – likely poor follow-through. Suggested daughter attend + look at community transport

5) Adherence / supports  
– Emphasised emollient = main long-term Rx  
– Asked daughter to put written plan on fridge + check creams weekly, call clinic before they run out  
– Note: chronic non-compliance – keep regimen simple

6) F/U / safety net  
– Review 2/52 – home visit if possible (or earlier if ↑redness, pain, pus, fevers, spreading rash)  
– Next visit: assess response, check for steroid atrophy, reinforce avoidance, re-check derm referral (consider telederm if can’t travel)  
– Plan U&E/eGFR and HTN/CKD review at separate appt 4–6/52

Bulk billed. Nurse to phone in 3–4 days to confirm scripts filled + using creams.

2) Chronic dermatitis (atopic + irritant) with pityriasis alba – mild hand flare only, face stable. Occupational irritant exposure ongoing.  
3) CALD, limited English – ↑ risk of misunderstanding treatment plan. Daughter translating; offered interpreter for future.

Headache  
- Reassured – no red flag features currently. Discussed red flag symptoms and to seek urgent care if sudden severe “worst ever” headache, fever/neck stiffness, confusion, weakness, visual change, difficulty speaking, vomiting, or if much worse.  
- Analgesia:  
  - Paracetamol 1 g up to QID PRN (max 4 g/24 h).  
  - May use ibuprofen 400 mg up to TDS PRN with food short term if tolerates, avoid if any GI upset/pregnancy.  
- Non-drug: encouraged fluids, short breaks from screens/noise where possible, simple neck/shoulder stretches. No imaging/bloods today – review if persists or pattern changes.  

Skin  
- Continue emollient frequently (esp after hand-washing). Suggested large pump pack, cheap fragrance-free sorbolene-type.  
- Hands: continue moderate potency steroid (mometasone 0.1% cream) OD to red/itchy areas only for up to 7 days then stop; otherwise moisturiser only. Avoid continuous daily steroid.  
- Face: hydrocortisone 1% thin layer OD up to 7 days only when red/itchy; otherwise moisturiser + gentle non-soap cleanser. Sun protection discussed briefly.  
- No antibiotics indicated – no signs of infection.  
- If ongoing frequent flares despite this, consider derm referral for patch testing (gloves/cleaners etc).

- Wrote very simple instructions (headache tablets, “red cream” vs “white cream”) for pt to take home; used diagrams.  
- Checked understanding by asking pt to show where to put which cream; initially wanted to put steroid over whole hands daily – corrected.  
- Suggested professional interpreter for longer/complex future appts; daughter agreeable if needed.  

Other  
- Pt mentioned “very tired all the time” right at end – no time to explore today. Asked to book longer appt for fatigue workup (bloods etc).  

F/U: 2 weeks with GP, earlier if headache persisting beyond ~1–2 weeks, worsening or changing character, or if skin flare not settling after 7–10 days / any signs of infection.

32F teacher – f/up rash + gut sx / ?food intolerance  

HPI  
Ongoing intermittent itchy rash forearms + ant neck x ~2/12. Comes/goes. Flares a few hrs post certain meals. Past 2/52 ~4–5 eps. No facial swell, no SOB, no wheeze, no throat tightness. No new meds/soaps etc per pt. Says “seems to blow up on nights I’ve had pasta or takeaway”. School hand sanitiser stings if already rashy.  

Longstanding IBS-type sx – bloating, crampy lower abdo pain, variable stool. No wt loss, no PR bleed, no noct diarrhoea, no fevers. No FHx bowel ca per old notes. Pt notes clearer link now with wheat (pasta/bread), onion/garlic, some fruit. “Feel foggy and wiped out on bad gut days”.  

Since last review 3/52 ago has done rough food/sx diary + ↓pasta, apples, onion/garlic → ~30–40% better bloating + fewer rash days. Wants more structured plan, “don’t want to cut whole food groups for no reason”.  

Meds  
- COCP (EE/levonorgestrel) stable  
- PRN simethicone OTC – some benefit  
NKDA. No prev anaphylaxis.  

Exam  
Obs ok: BP 112/70 HR 74 afeb SpO2 99% RA BMI 23  
Skin: faint erythematous macular rash L forearm flexor, non-vesic, non-purpuric, no warmth, no angioedema, no mucosal inv.  
Abdo: soft, mildly bloated, NT, no masses, BS N. Chest clear.  

Impression  
1) Suspected food intolerance / IBS-type functional GI disorder  
   - Sx pattern (bloating + “brain fog” + mild rash) temporally related to high-FODMAP foods (wheat, onion/garlic, some fruit).  
   - No features IgE-mediated allergy (no urticaria with systemic sx, no anaphylaxis).  
   - No red flags for IBD/malignancy/systemic autoimmune at present.  

2) IBS-type functional GI disorder – ongoing but improving with informal dietary mods  

3) Mild intermittent eczematous/irritant rash forearms/neck  
   - Likely irritant + background sensitivity (hand sanitiser/soaps) ± flaring with systemic sx. No infection, no serious derm.  

Plan  
- Explained likely food intolerance vs allergy (dose-dependent, non-IgE, no anaphylaxis) in brief. Advised no point doing IgE/skin tests/breath tests currently.  
- Start structured low FODMAP-style exclusion 4–6/52 as diagnostic trial (NOT long-term strict).  
- Referral APD (IBS/low FODMAP exp) – for detailed plan + reintro phase + nutrition adequacy.  
- Continue food/sx diary (meals, bloating, stool, rash, “brain fog”).  
- If no sig improvement after ~4/52 good adherence → reconsider dx, poss further Ix / GI review. If better → graded reintro with APD to ID specific triggers, aim least restrictive diet.  
- Meds:  
  - Continue PRN simethicone.  
  - Antispasmodic (e.g. hyoscine butylbromide) discussed, pt prefers wait and see diet effect.  
- Skin:  
  - Likely irritant/eczema. Use bland moisturiser/soap substitute, minimise harsh sanitiser where poss.  
  - Short course OTC hydrocortisone 1% BD 5–7/7 during flares ok (avoid prolonged use esp face/neck).  
- No new bloods today – prev coeliac serol, FBC, CRP last year all N; no new red flags.  

Safety net  
- Red flag counsel: RTC/ED if wt loss, PR bleed, persistent vomiting, fevers, severe abdo pain, or any anaphylaxis sx (facial/tongue swell, trouble breathing, throat tight, generalised hives).  

F/up  
- Review 5–6/52 (long appt) after diet trial + APD review.  
- Can book separate appt re broader IBS mgmt (stress, work triggers, meds) – not done today (time).  

Billing: Level B, bulk billed.

1) Fatigue, subacute, non-specific, 54yo M

2) Pterygium OU (L>R), symptomatic  
   – Likely UV-related. Mild ↓VA L, needs formal refraction/slit lamp.

2) Pterygium

Standard consult, bulk billed.

22/11/25 14:05 Tel consult  

32F RN, SA background, Aus resident  

Reason: “general check up” → fatigue  

Hx  
~3–4/12 ↑tired “bit more wiped out than usual” most days. Worse after late/long shifts, esp nights. Says “dragging myself through the day”, often needs to lie down after work. Still FT work but ↓gym (was 4x/wk → now 1–2).  
Sleep: 5–6h on work nights, 7–8h days off. Trouble winding down after nights, on phone in bed. No known snoring/apnoeas (lives alone). No waking SOB, no AM headaches.  
Assoc sx: mild tension-type HA, occasional postural light-headed. No SOB at rest, no CP, no palps, no oedema. No fevers, night sweats, rigors. No cough, haemoptysis. Wt stable (maybe -1–2kg, attributes to skipped meals).  
Mood: “bit flat and snappy after nights” but denies persistent low mood, anhedonia, SI. Still enjoys social time when not too tired. Work stress + double shifts, feels “probably just the hours and too much coffee”. Reluctant for meds/tests.  
Past TB lung ~5y ago o/seas, completed 6/12 Rx per pt, no issues since, no resp sx now. No known DM, thyroid, HIV, hep, autoimmune. Hx “low iron ages ago”.  
Meds: PRN ibuprofen, OTC multivit on/off. High caffeine (coffee + energy drinks nights). NKDA.  
SHx: RN rotating roster, frequent OT. Nonsmoker, minimal EtOH, no rec drugs.  

Telehealth → no exam / obs  

Impression  
1) Fatigue subacute–chronic, likely multifactorial (shift work + poor sleep hygiene + high caffeine + irregular diet ± IDA / metabolic / thyroid / vit deficiency). No red flag features on hx.  
2) Hx pulmonary TB, treated, quiescent by hx. Low suspicion relapse but given hx + fatigue + HCW → screen.  
3) Occupational stress / shift-work related issues, no clear MDD currently but monitor.  

Plan  
Ix (forms emailed + in EMR, local path):  
- FBC, ESR, CRP  
- U&E, LFT  
- Fasting BSL, HbA1c, fasting lipids  
- Iron studies (ferritin, iron, transferrin sat)  
- B12, folate, Vit D  
- TSH, fT4  
- Quantiferon TB (IGRA)  
- HIV, Hep B, Hep C serology (discussed occupational risk, pt consents)  
- Serum β-hCG  
- Urinalysis (MSU if abn)  

F2F review 1–2/52 → BP, HR, Wt/BMI, full cardioresp + abdo. Will give CXR req then (TB hx + fatigue). Consider further (sleep study / MH plan / specialist) depending on results + ongoing sx.  

Advice (brief)  
- Cut out energy drinks, limit coffee ≤2/day, avoid caffeine close to sleep.  
- Try better wind-down after nights, minimise phone in bed.  
- Encouraged small regular meals on shift, gentle ex as tolerated.  
- Discuss with NUM re OT if ongoing.  

Red flags discussed: seek urgent review/ED if SOB, CP, palps + dizziness/syncope, high fevers, night sweats, haemoptysis, rapid wt loss, focal neuro sx, or if feels “really crook”.  

Pt initially wanted to “just cut back on coffee first” but agreed to targeted bloods, keen to avoid unnecessary meds/referrals.  

Follow-up: std 15 min F2F booked ~1–2/52

22/11/2025  

Reason for visit:  
RACF reveiw – abnormla bloods (low Na, worsening renal fn) in pt on treamtent for urosepsis.  

HPI:  
74yo male in RACF, known HTN, T2DM, probable CKD. Seen in room after RN faxed path from Sullivan Nicolaides: Na 124 (was 133 four days ago), Cr 245 (baseline ~110–120), eGFR ~20 (prev ~55–60). Urosepsis dx 5 days ago by after hrs GP, now on IV ceftrixone via facillity protocol.  

Pt reports 2–3 days ↑ fatigue, “washed out”, mild nausea, more unsteady on feet. No vomitting, no diarrhoea. No CP, no SOB. ↓ urine vol, darker, over last 1–2 days. No frank confuson but “slower” per wife on phone.  

Meds (per chart):  
- Perindopril 5mg mane  
- Furosemide 20mg mane  
- Metformin 500mg bd  
- Atorvastatin 20mg nocte  
- Paracetmol 1g prn (using reg past week)  
- Ceftriaxone 1g IV daily (day 2, after 3d trimethoprim/sulfamethoxzole)  

Allergies: NKDA  

Examination:  
Looks tired, in bed.  
Obs (RACF + my check): T 37.4, HR 96 reg, BP 96/58 sitting (rep 92/54, a bit light headed), RR 18, SpO2 97% RA.  
Neuro: A&O x3, mild psychomotor slowing, no focal neurology, no asterexis.  
Chest clear. HS dual, no murmur. JVP not clearly up.  
Abdo soft, NT, no CVA tendneress.  
Mild chronic ankle oedema bilat. Mucous membs slightly dry – borderline hypovolaemic vs euvol.  

Recent tests (SN path 22/11, revieiwed today):  
- Na 124  
- K 5.2  
- Cl 89  
- HCO3 21  
- Urea 25 ↑  
- Cr 245 ↑ (x2+ baseline)  
- eGFR ~20  
- Glucose 7.8 (fasting)  
- CRP 86 (down from >150 per RN record)  
- WCC 11.5 (neuts, down from 15)  
- LFTs WNL, Alb 33 (sl low)  

Urinalysis (today, MSU): SG 1.020, prot +, blood trace, nitrite +, LE + (ongoing UTI, but clincially improved, afebrile since last night).  

Impression:  
1) Hyponatraemia (Na 124, falling) – likley hypovolaemic / mixed in setting sepsis, AKI, ACEI + diurtic. Mild sx (weak, unsteady).  
2) Acute kidney injury on probable CKD3a – KDIGO stage 2–3 (Cr >2x baseline). Likley pre-renal / ATN from sepsis + meds.  
3) Urosepsis – clincially improving (afebrile, CRP/WCC down) but now c/b AKI + low Na.  
4) Hypotension – multifactorial (sepsis physio, ACEI, diuretic). Borderline haemodynamically, RACF not safe for ongoing managment.  
5) Background T2DM, HTN, hyperlip – deprioritised today.  

Plan:  
Given age, AKI, Na 124, low BP and RACF limits → needs urgent hospital assesment.  

- Cease perindopril now.  
- Cease furosemide now.  
- Cease metformin (eGFR ~20, lactic acidosis risk).  
- Avoid NSAIDs (RN informed).  
- Continue IV ceftriaxone 1g daily as charted until review in ED (dose to be checked there re renal fn).  
- Encourage small sips PO while awaiting ambuance, avoid large fluid bolus here due to Na and uncertain vol status.  

Transfer:  
- Discussed with pt and daugther (EPOA) by phone – both agree to hosp transfer for “kidneys and salts” and closer monitoring.  
- Spoke to ED reg at Royal [City] Hosp via direct line – handover given: 74yo RACF resident with urosepsis on IV ceftriaxone, new AKI (Cr 245, eGFR 20), Na 124, BP ~90s syst, borderline but stable, no confusion, no seizures. Needs IV fluids, UEC monitoring, renal assesment, possible nephrology.  
- Ambulance booked as urgent (not code 1).  
- Printed med chart + latest path + brief transfer summary sent with pt.  

Request for ED/inpatient (not done here):  
- Repeat UEC, CMP, FBC, CRP, blood cultures if any concern.  
- Serum/urine osmolality, urine Na to clarify hyponatraemia aetiology.  
- VBG/ABG if indicated.  
- Renal tract US to r/o obstruction.  
- Strict fluid balance, daily weights.  
- Slow Na correction (≤8–10 mmol/L/24h).  
- Avoid contrast, other nephrotoxins. Nephro consult if ongoing AKI. Dialyisis only if standard indications.  

Carer input:  
RN reports ↓ urine output vs baseline and “just not himself, more tired”. Wife on phone says he has been “slower on the phone” last 2 days.  

Billing:  
RACF visit – bulk billed (DVA Gold card).  

Follow up:  
Will review hosp discharge summary when avail via HealthLink and arrange RACF post-discharge reveiw 3–5 days after return. RN to call practice if deterioration while waiting amb.

22/11/25 10:15 – Home visit – Brisbane

Reason: pt asked for home visit to “go through all the blood tests and scans properly, the calcium and the vitamin thing”.

79F, lives alone, known primary hyperparathyroidism, osteoporosis, Vit D deficiency, HTN, HLD.

Very tangential historian, long stories re neighbour, Google etc, needed repeated redirection. Main concern = meaning of recent bloods + fear of “too much calcium hardening arteries / kidney stones from vitamin D”.

Path results (S&N, done earlier this month – copied from last review, checked today):
- Corr Ca 2.82 mmol/L (prev 2.88)
- PTH 15 pmol/L (↑, similar to prior)
- eGFR 64 mL/min (stable), Cr 78
- Phosphate low–normal
- 25-OH Vit D 44 nmol/L (prev 28)
- ALP mildly ↑

Known hx:
- Primary hyperparathyroidism x ~3 yrs, likely single adenoma. Endocrinology at tertiary centre, last seen ~6/12 ago. Surgery discussed previously – pt strongly reluctant, endo happy with conservative mx while Ca only mildly ↑, kidneys ok, no stones, largely asx.
- Osteoporosis (DEXA ~18/12 ago: LS ~–2.8, hip ~–2.6). On alendronate weekly + Vit D. No Ca tabs.
- Vit D deficiency – on colecalciferol 1000 IU daily.
- No known CKD, no nephrolithiasis hx.

Today – symptoms:
Denies classic hyperCa sx: no polyuria, no polydipsia, bowels ok, no N/V, no acute confusion (daughter also apparently not concerned per phone last week). Longstanding mild fatigue only. No flank pain/haematuria. Chronic low back ache unchanged.

Meds (checked Webster in kitchen):
- Alendronate 70 mg weekly (Sat)
- Colecalciferol 1000 IU daily
- Perindopril 5 mg mane
- Atorvastatin 20 mg nocte
- Paracetamol 1 g QID PRN
No Ca supplements (stopped ~18/12 ago). No OTC/herbals currently.

Obs at home:
BP 136/72, HR 76 reg, RR 16, SpO2 97% RA, afebrile. Looks well, hydrated, ambulates slowly with 4WW.

Brief exam only (time):
CVS/resp unremarkable, abdo soft NT, no CVA tenderness. No focal bone tenderness. Gait slow but steady with 4WW.

Assessment (scattered):

1) Primary hyperparathyroidism with chronic mild hypercalcaemia – stable  
Ca still only mildly ↑ and slightly improved vs last. PTH still ↑ as expected. Renal function preserved. No sx of severe hyperCa. Ongoing conservative mx appropriate per endo.

2) Osteoporosis – high fracture risk but clinically stable  
On bisphosphonate + Vit D, no recent falls or fractures. Some home falls risks (loose rugs).

3) Vit D deficiency – improving, still suboptimal  
44 nmol/L on 1000 IU daily. Need modest improvement only, avoid overtreatment given hyperPTH.

4) Communication style – tangential, but intact cognition once redirected. Impacts time/coverage of issues.

Plan:

Hyperparathyroidism / Ca:
- Continue current conservative approach.
- Reassured re: current Ca level, explained no urgent concern today.
- Avoid Ca supplements; dietary Ca in moderation ok.
- Encourage adequate fluids (no strict target documented).
- Tests ordered today via QML: UEC, CMP (incl Ca/PO4), PTH, 25-OH Vit D in 6/12 (or earlier if sx). Put reminder in system.
- Will forward summary + latest results to endocrinology before next review (~6/12).

Osteoporosis:
- Continue alendronate 70 mg weekly. Reiterated admin (upright 30 min, full glass water, empty stomach) as she reports occasional reflux when lies back down.
- Continue colecalciferol 1000 IU daily.
- DEXA: due around 2-year mark (another 6–12/12) – to arrange at clinic visit rather than from home (transport/logistics). Note in recall: “DEXA ~late 2026”.
- Falls/home safety briefly: advised removal/taping of loose hallway rugs; she will ask home care worker.

Vit D:
- Keep colecalciferol 1000 IU daily only. No high-dose loading.
- Aim Vit D ~50–80 nmol/L – recheck with 6/12 bloods.
- Reassured that at this dose + current Ca, kidney stone risk low, but we’re monitoring.

Other chronic issues:
- HTN, lipids appear stable today, scripts ok. Comprehensive chronic disease review (BP trend, lipids, vaccines, mood/cognition) deferred – asked to book longer appt (home or clinic) in 2–3/12.

Follow-up:
- GP review 2–3/12 (home vs clinic depending on mobility) for broader chronic care + check progress with home safety.
- Repeat bloods 6/12 as above unless new sx.
- Urgent review/ED if: new confusion, severe constipation or vomiting, can’t keep fluids down, new severe bone pain or fracture, marked ↑ thirst/urination, flank pain/haematuria.

Pt understanding:
She was able to summarise back (in her own way): “keep sipping water, don’t go mad on the cheese, stay on the little vitamin D, ring if I start weeing heaps or get really muddled”. Left brief written summary + copy of key results for her/daughter.

22/11/25  09:10  

Reason for visit: cough f/up (also Hirschsprung/constipation q’s)

24yo male, apprentice sparky. Known Hirschsprung s/p childhood surgery, on regular Movicol.

Cough  
- Ongoing ~2 wks, I saw him last week here – viral URTI dx then, no abx.  
- Still mainly dry cough, “bit of white gunk in the morning sometimes”. No blood.  
- Worse at night / on waking, wakes him a few times but goes back to sleep.  
- No SOB, no chest pain, no wheeze, no fever now. “Felt a bit hot first couple of days, all good now.”  
- Non-smoker, no vape, no ACEi. No asthma hx.  
- Thinks maybe “from the dust at work” + “house is a bit musty, old heater, smells no good”.  
- Still working, no exertional limitation.

Bowels / Hirschsprung  
- Longstanding post-surgical constipation, usually 1 stool/day or q2d on Movicol 1–2 sachets.  
- Last ~2 wks “a bit more backed up” – stool q2–3d, harder but still passing, no pain.  
- Denies abdo distension, severe cramps, vomiting, overflow diarrhoea, PR bleed.  
- Asking “Do I need to change anything with my laxatives when I get crook?”

Obs  
BP 118/72, HR 78, RR 16, T 36.7, SpO₂ 99% RA. Looks well, talking full sentences, occasional dry cough.  

Chest clear on ausc, good AE, no added sounds. Throat mildly red, nasal mucosa a bit boggy, otherwise unremarkable. Abd soft, non-distended, mild stooly feel LLQ only, non-tender.

Impression  
1) Subacute cough ~2/40 – likely post-viral ± mild upper airway irritation (dust, post-nasal drip). No red flags today, exam/vitals reassuring. No indication for CXR/abx at this stage.  
2) Hirschsprung disease with chronic constipation – currently reasonably controlled, mild slowing with recent illness, no features of obstruction/megacolon.  
3) Occupational/environmental irritants (dusty sites, old heater) probably contributing.

Plan  
- No abx.  
- Trial non-sedating antihistamine for possible post-nasal drip: cetirizine 10 mg nocte x 7–10 days (OTC, PBS if script but advised he can just buy it). Warned may cause some drowsiness – “see how you go with the first one before driving”.  
- Continue simple measures (lozenges, warm drinks, paracetamol PRN).  
- Strongly advised consistent mask use at dusty job sites; suggested landlord/agent get heater checked/cleaned.

Bowels:  
- OK to increase Movicol up to 2–3 sachets/day short term if >2 days no BM or stool hard, then reduce back to usual once back to daily soft stool.  
- Emphasised need to seek urgent care if new abdo distension, severe colicky pain, persistent vomiting, no wind/stool, or sudden watery “overflow” with pain/distension given Hirschsprung hx.

Investigations today: nil. Will order CXR ± spirometry if cough >4–6 wks or earlier if SOB, wheeze, haemoptysis, systemic symptoms.

Follow-up  
- Review with me or any GP in ~2 wks if cough not settling, sooner if worse / red flags.  
- Longer 20–30 min appt in 2–3 months to go through adult bowel management plan and consider gastro/colorectal referral + try to get old surgical notes.  
- Pt also wants “a general check-up and some bloods” – deferred today due to time, asked him to book separate routine check.

Pt able to repeat back red flag sx for both cough and bowel issues. Seems reliable with meds.

Billing: standard Level B, bulk billed. 09:28

22/11/25 – RACF round – f/up review in room  

CC  
“Sore throat, chest + throat crook again”, URTI sx ~3 days. Staff asked for review.

HPI  
83y F in RACF, known pt, h/o GORD, chronic rhinosinustis, allergic rhinitus. Longstanding poor med complaiance.

3 days URTI:
- main c/o sore throat, worse yest “like razor blades”, a bit better today  
- mild blocked nose + clear runny nose, on/off dry cough, no wheeze  
- no documented fevers; pt “felt a bit hot last night”, no rigors  
- eating/drinking ok but ↓ appetite. No diffculty w liquids, no drooling  
- denies SOB, CP, abdo pain, D+V  

Thinks aircon “blowing on my neck” caused it. Also blames “those reflux tablets” and has been skipping them: “I ran out… didn’t bother saying anything”. Staff confirm multiple PPI refusals over last mth.

Baseline chronic rhinosinusitis/allergic rhinitis – daily congestion, forgets steroid spray “half the time”. No new facial pain, no purulent d/c.

GORD – was well controlled on PPI, now more night throat clearing + some retrosternal discomfort on some nights, not acute today.

Examination (focused)  
Gen: Thin elderly, mildly unwell but comfy, talking full sentances.  
Obs: T 37.4, HR 82 reg, BP 138/74, RR 16, SpO₂ 97% RA.  
Throat: erythematous pharynx/soft palate, no tonsillar exudate, small tonsils, uvula midline, no drooling, no trismus.  
Neck: small tender ant cerv nodes, mobile, no swellling.  
Chest: clear, good AE, no wheeze/crackles.  
Abdo: soft, NT.

Impression  
1. Acute pharyngitis / URTI – likely viral (cough, rhinorhoea, low/no fever, no exudate, not high‑risk ARF). No signs deep neck infection/airway compromise.  
2. Chronic rhinosinusitis + allergic rhinitus – suboptimally controlled, contributing to ongoing throat irritation/postnasal drip.  
3. GORD – poorly controlled due to non‑adherance; may add to chronic throat sx.  
4. Ongoing med refusals / ?mild cognative issues – needs simple plan + RACF support.

Plan  
URTI / throat  
- No abx – discussed viral picture with pt.  
- Paracetamol 1g QID PRN pain/fever (max 4g/day) – already charted; RN to offer more regularly next 1–2 days if throat pain limiting intake.  
- Saline gargles + warm fluids, soft diet as tolerated.  
- Lozenges PRN if RN happy with swallowing.

Red flags – RN to call GP/ambulance if: fever ≥38 persisting, worse throat pain, can’t swallow / refusing fluids, drooling, muffled voice, neck swelling, stridor, SOB, or genrally much more crook.

Ix  
- Nil today – no throat swab/bloods as mild, stable.  
- If not improving or worse >5–7 days, consider throat swab + FBE/CRP (QML/SNP as per facility).

Rhinosinusitis / allergic rhinitus  
- Re‑explained need for regular steroid spray to reduce congestion + throat irritation. Pt: “I forget the nose stuff all the time” but agrees if staff bring with morning meds.  
- RN: please prompt daily mometasone nasal spray as charted for at least 4/52, document refusals.  
- Saline nasal spray PRN if available.

GORD  
- Continue esomeprazole 20mg mane with breakfast. RN to supervise, record any refusals.  
- Briefly explained reflux can make throat “feel funny”; pt says “If it helps the throat, I’ll try”. Will need more detailed GORD review later (diet, nocturnal sx, bone risk) – book longer appt 2–4/52.

Adherance / cognition  
- Asked RN to keep closer note of refused meds (PPI + nasal spray esp) and gently reinforce why they’re needed when offering.  
- Plan longer review with daughter/EPOA present for adherence strategies + possible cog screen.

Follow‑up  
- Review on next routine RACF round ~1 week – check throat, obs, oral intake.  
- Earlier review if any deterioration as above.

[Added 16:30 by Dr L. Chan – phoned RN]  
RN reports pt ate lunch well, took paracetamol and PPI this morn, declined nasal spray “too much fuss” – refusal noted. No fever, obs stable. Plan unchanged, re‑address nasal spray at next visit.

22/11/25  09:12  

72F (retired admin) – constipation / “holding on to my bowels and getting blocked up again”  

Long hx functional constipation, faecal overflow. Seen here on/off last 2–3 yrs, lots of DNAs. Known to me.  

Today:  
- Several months ↑ stool holding as “it hurts when it finally comes out” + doesn’t like public toilets.  
- Opening bowels maybe 1–2x/week, very large hard stools, painful, sometimes blocks toilet.  
- Daily small-volume soiling in underwear last few weeks (“skid marks… just leaks out”).  
- Feels bloated, incomplete emptying, dull lower abdo discomfort.  
- Admits not taking Movicol as prescribed, ran out “weeks ago”, forgot to get more. Similar with perindopril/atorva – poor adherence generally.  

Neg: no PR blood, no melena, wt stable, no fevers, no N/V, no urinary sx, no neuro red flags (no saddle anaesthesia, leg weakness).  

PMHx (relevant):  
- Chronic functional constipation with prior faecal impactions, overflow incontinence.  
- HTN, hyperlipidaemia, OA knees.  
- Colonoscopy ~8 yrs ago reportedly normal.  

Meds (as actually taking):  
- Perindopril 5 mg mane – often missed.  
- Atorvastatin 20 mg nocte – “when I remember”.  
- Movicol macrogol 3350 + electrolytes – currently nil.  
- Paracetamol PRN.  
NKDA.  

Lives alone, low activity, low fibre diet, mainly tea, limited water.  

Exam (focused):  
Looks well, mobile, a bit anxious, faint faecal odour.  
BP 138/82, HR 76 reg, afebrile, BMI ~26.  
Abdo: soft, mildly distended, generalised fullness esp LLQ, mild discomfort only, no peritonism, no obvious mass.  
PR (chaperone present): perianal irritation, small amount soft stool externally. Good tone. Rectum loaded with large amount firm stool, no discrete mass, no fissures/haemorrhoids seen, no fresh blood.  

Impression:  
1) Faecal impaction with overflow incontinence (encopresis) – clinically loaded rectum, classic hx of stool retention + daily soiling.  
2) Chronic functional constipation – behavioural (delaying defecation), low fibre/fluids, low activity, poor adherence to laxatives.  
3) Medication non-adherence / poor engagement – misses meds, DNAs, didn’t attend nurse bowel review or gastro appt.  

Plan (limited time today – bowels only, chronic disease review separate):  

- Oral disimpaction at home:  
  • Restart macrogol 3350 + electrolytes (Movicol).  
  • Days 1–3: 1 sachet hourly up to max 8/day (can space to 2‑hourly if cramps/bloating). Aim for large stool output / clear liquid stools.  
  • Then switch to maintenance: 1–2 sachets daily ongoing, titrate to keep soft stool at least every 1–2 days. Emphasised not to stop once better. Written instructions given.  

- Scripts:  
  • Movicol sachets – qty for 3–5 days intensive + ≥1 month maintenance. PBS script printed.  

- Simple routine advice only (kept brief): sit on toilet after meals, avoid “holding on”, keep feet supported. Encouraged ↑ water intake and a bit more fibre but didn’t go into huge detail today.  

- Ix:  
  FBE, U&E, LFT, Ca, Mg, PO4, fasting BSL, TSH ordered via Sullivan Nicolaides – baseline and to monitor with laxatives. Results pending. Will consider FIT / repeat colonoscopy discussion once settled.  

- Safety-net:  
  Told to seek urgent review / ED if severe abdo pain, vomiting, unable to pass wind, new PR bleeding/black stools, fever, or new urinary retention/leg weakness/numbness around anus.  

- Follow-up:  
  Review booked 1 week to check response to disimpaction, adjust Movicol dose, review bloods.  
  Separate longer 20‑min appt in 4–6 wks for HTN/lipids/med adherence (annual health check) – today not covered.  

Pt a bit reluctant about frequent toilet trips during disimpaction but agreed to start tomorrow when home all day. Declined nurse phone check; says will come back if “it’s not working”.  

Bulk billed.  

09:27 – note finished (chronic disease section from 03/05/23 left for next visit – not updated today).

Came in saying wants a “proper check-up head to toe” and very worried about “lazy eye turning into something serious like cancer or blindness / brain tumour”. Lots of reading online. No acute sx today – specifically denies headache, diplopia, eye pain, photophobia, sudden vision change, flashes/floaters, focal neuro sx.

Known: L amblyopia + strabismus since childhood, myopia/astigmatism, mild spastic diplegic CP (independent). No regular meds, NKDA. No hx DM/HTN.

Keeps asking about “full body scan just to be sure”. Explained we don’t do whole body scans in absence of sx, risk of incidental findings etc. Reassured that CP does not ↑ risk of “eye cancer” on current evidence.

Eyes today:
- VA with glasses: R 6/6, L 6/18 → ~6/12 pinhole (same amblyopic pattern as hx)
- Mild constant L esotropia
- EOMI, pupils normal, fields grossly intact
- Fundoscopy: discs sharp, no papilloedema, no obvious retinal lesions

Neuro screen essentially baseline for her CP – mild ↑ tone LL, walks independently, CN grossly intact.

Vitals all normal, BMI ~23.

Impression:
1. General health check – well, no red flags on hx/exam.
2. Longstanding L amblyopia/strabismus + refractive error – stable pattern, no signs of acute ocular or intracranial pathology.
3. Mild CP – stable.
4. Marked health anxiety / reassurance seeking around vision and cancer; no current risk issues disclosed.

Plan:
- Explained findings and that current exam not suggestive of tumour / acute eye disease.
- Encouraged wearing glasses esp at work/driving (she often doesn’t due to feeling self‑conscious).
- Referral to ophthalmology for formal review (vision, refraction, strabismus/amblyopia) – last specialist >5 yrs. Asked to book in next few months, sooner if sx change.
- Bloods ordered as part of general screen (pt keen): FBC, U&E, LFT, fasting lipids, fasting glucose/HbA1c, TSH.
- Cervical screen up to date (next due ~2 yrs). No STI screen today (low risk, declined).
- Brief discussion that excessive internet searching likely fuelling anxiety; suggested we book longer appt to focus on this (MHCP + psychology/CBT for health anxiety). She agrees in principle but still asking “are you sure we shouldn’t do more tests today?” → reiterated no red flags, tests guided by sx.

Safety net: return earlier / urgent review if sudden change in vision, new severe headache, focal neuro deficit, or other concerning sx.

Follow‑up: 2–3/52 for blood results + more time for anxiety/mental health and to check she has made ophthal appt.

Path forms reprinted – pt misplaced original on way out, reissued. She again asked about “MRI just to check my brain”. Re‑explained no indication at present; will revisit if new sx arise.
